notes.title: Skinwalker Hunt early access release date announcement!
notes.notes:
My new horror hunting game Skinwalker Hunt will be released into steam early access on June 4, 2021.

I want to use this opportunity to say thank you to all playtesters who helped me significantly improve the quality of the game.

Recently I've uploaded new screenshot from Skinwalker Hunt. Here's it is if you haven't seen it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36841326/8057835c5e590c6f878732dc23e8a089c2868088.jpg

notes.title: 1.18 Small improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.18 is now live.

Changelog:
There are some changes in behavior and health amount for first stage of  [spoiler]son of the devil[/spoiler] boss, that should make this gameplay section more dynamic.
Added rotating shadows effect for two boss fights.
Added delete saves button to options menu.
Fixed bug, that caused controller calibrate button to not work.
Fixed audio glitch that sometimes could be heard after killing a boss.
Improvements in German texts. (contributed by David Bicer)
Other small changes and improvements.


P.S. If you like Witch Hunt, you'll probably should check my new hunting horror game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/993110/Skinwalker_Hunt/

notes.title: v1.15 Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.15 is now live.

Changelog:
Previously, when player tried to stand on not very steep inclined surfaces, he was slowly sliding down. This is now fixed.
Player now hides his weapon from the screen when he is swimming.
There was a bug that increased head bob after player twisted his ankle. This is now fixed.
Other small changes.


P.S. Version 1.14 fixed issue where crouch icon sometimes was visible when you were not crouching.

notes.title: v1.06 Small update.
notes.notes:
Version 1.06 is now live.

Changelog:
- Texture on lockpicks pack is now more bright, to make it more visible.
- Fixed bug that caused screen to sometimes stay blurry around corners of the screen when player is not in aim mode.
- Fixed visual bug that made some dry bushes to change size, depending on a distance to the player.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v1.05 Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Version 1.05 is now live.

Changelog:
- Fixed issue that caused some NPCs to be invisible at medium distances.
- Sometimes perma mode didn't launch properly. I've made changes that might fix this issue.
- Made some changes to improve performance.

notes.title: v0.94 New beast 3d model and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Version 0.94 is now live.

Changelog:
- New 3d model and animations for the beast.
- Small AI changes for the beast.
- Made some changes to white ghost logic, that may help with stuck ghost issue.
- Fixed a bug in bell logic, that allowed to spawn a huge amount of spiders.
- Fixed bug that made beast headshots didn't count towards headhunter achievement.
- Sometimes fast reload skill didn't change reload speed of a flintlock pistol. I've made some changes that may solve this issue.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.91 New pistol animations and crawler changes.
notes.notes:
Version 0.91 is now live.

Changelog:
- New flintlock pistol animations.
- Made crawler a bit slower.
- Reduced chance of crawler encounter in some specific circumstances.
- It was possible to get stuck near white spirit. This is now fixed.
- Fixed some internal errors. This should reduce probability of crashes.
- Improved Russian translation.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.85 Bug fixes and some other improvements.
notes.notes:
Version 0.85 is now live.

Changelog:
- Added moving fog cloud to forest level.
- New UI for receiving money event.
- New art for the face of whisperer.
- Added visual effect for witch death.
- Now deadblind will be able to hear gunshots.
- Improved horse animation on final cutscene.
- Reconfigured new fog clouds, to make it more performant.
- It was possible to spawn under the ground when second chance was triggered. This should be fixed now.
- Now using Evil Sight skill will not save player from whisperer.
- Now when second chance skill gets triggered player becomes invulnerable for 6 seconds.
- There was a bug with final boss when he sometimes stayed underwater and didn't rise when player approached him. This is now fixed.
- Fixed bug that made witch on stage 2, sometimes become invaluable after she used a teleport.
- Fixed bug where activating Evil Sight using inventory button consumed only 30 mana instead of 50.
- Fixed bug that sometimes made doctor heal player to the incorrect amount of health.
- Fixed empty tip issue.
- Made fireball splash and lightning strike decal not visible through a fog.
- Fixed bug that made safe closed after game load, when it was already opened.
- Small improvements to forest level.
- Other small fixes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.84 Improved inventory, bug fixes and more.
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/20e75dd3d7eecc144eb612c244106f6402b36fca.jpg

Version 0.84 is now live.

Changelog:
- Inventory design improved. Now most items displayed as icons.
- Made some improvements to sacrificial tree AI.
- Deadblind will now attack player if it gets to close.
- Improved player physics object friction. It should be less sticky when colliding with flat objects like walls.

- Moved necronomicon to new position.
- Made cannon cave and shed accessible for AI.
- Fixed bug that made witch invisible and invaluable, if she attacked player in invisible state and triggered second chance skill.
- Fixed bug that could make main menu unresponsive to input.
- Removed invisible extra skill book from black hole cave chest.
- Made a witch a bit slower in tree protecting stage.
- Made dogs a bit bigger.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.83 (Eng, Рус, 中文) New Darkness sense logic, major balance changes, level design improvements and more.
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/5ccbbc35d5a92307e016477d6e2cf70122986b83.jpg

Version 0.83 is now live. This is probably the most controversial update to Witch Hunt, cause it drastically changes core hunting mechanic of the game and introduces major balance changes, so there's bound to be people who will not like it. For that reason I've made previous version of the game available to public through a seperate steam branch.

Changelog:
- Darkness sense skill significantly changed. It no longer consumes mana but works differently.
- Major balance changes.
- Added heavy foggy valley to the forest level.
- New tutorial.
- Level design improvements on forest level.
- Level design improvements on Bellville level.
- Made some improvements to path preferences of bosses.
- Second chance skill will now teleport you to random position.
- Bell sound will now attract enemies if they are nearby.
- Changed Bellville music on day 3.
- If you encounter whisperer it will now attempt to consume 100 mana. Only if you don't have 100 mana, you'll receive additional damage depending on how much mana you've had.
- Fast travel skill now requires full health and consumes 100 mana.
- Spiders no longer spawn mana.
- Tips, texts, video and everything related to old Darkness sense mechanic changed or removed.
- Lightning sound radius increased.
- New icon for silver crucifix ready status.
- Fixed a bug that prevented poisonous plant death sound to be heard.
- Fixed a bug that spawned two watcher totems after game loading.
- Fixed two bugs related to lockpick master skill.
- Small improvements to design of trader shop.
- More healing plants added to Bellville.
- Other small changes and improvements.

 If you want get old version with old Darkness Sense:
 
 1. In your Steam client, go to the Library and right (mouse button) click on Witch Hunt
 2. Select Properties (from context menu)
 3. Select the Betas tab
 4. Select Version_082 from the list on click ok

Русский:
Это, наверное, самое спорное обновление для Witch Hunt, так как оно кардинально меняет основную механику охоты. Поэтому я уверен, что будут люди, которым это не понравится. По этой причине я сделал прошлую версию игры доступной для скачивания через отдельную Steam ветку.
 
 Если вы хотите скачать версию со старой механикой "Чувство тьмы":
 
 1. В своей библиотеке кликните правой кнопкой мышки на Witch Hunt.
 2. В контекстном меню кликните properties (свойства)
 3. Кликните на закладку Betas (Бета-Версии)
 4. Выберите ветку Version_082 из выпадающего списка.

中文
这可能是女巫猎人最具争议的更新，因为它大大改变了游戏的核心狩猎机制，所以肯定会有人不喜欢它。 出于这个原因，我在steam游戏属性中的测试栏单独发布了以前的版本。 
如果您还想使用老版本的黑暗感官，那么请:

1.打开您的steam客户端，进入游戏库，并用鼠标右击Witch Hunt
2.选择属性（从菜单中）
3.选择测试选项
4.在列表中点击选择  Version_082即可

notes.title: v0.82 Some changes related to AI, UI and balance.
notes.notes:
Version 0.81 is now live. 

Changelog:
- Changed behavior of undead dogs and humans when player is unreachable for AI.
- Deadblind now spawns 100 mana cloud on death.
- Fast travel points no longer require player to have full health.
- Evil sight can now be activated with button (Default: v)
- Changed some scripted events.
- New interface and sound for some game informational messages.
- Now player is healed from poisoning when he loads the game. To prevent endless loop of death for players who saved while being poisoned.
- Small level design changes on Bellville level, related to in-game events.
- Some fixes related to doll logic.
- There was a method to abuse game rules that allowed to find Witch super quickly. This is now fixed.
- Fast travel point is now marked on the map.
- New player icon for the map.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.80 A hotfix for version 0.79
notes.notes:
Version 0.80 is now live. It's a hotfix for version 0.79

Changelog:
- Fixed bug that didn't allow player to rebind controls.

notes.title: v0.79 Additional rewards, small barn changes and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Version 0.79 is now live. This update will reset your key bindings to default!

Changelog:
- Small barn is now locked until you kill sacrificial tree.
- Small barn now contains loot and environmental storytelling content.
- In addition to money, mayor will now also reward you with ammo after you kill the beast.
- Changed behavior of church front doors to prevent player from getting stuck there.
- Fixed some places where player could get stuck.
- Solved issue that made menus stop responding to controller input after player rebinds controller buttons.
- Other small changes.

notes.title: v0.78 Church stuck bug fix
notes.notes:
Version 0.78 is now live. It's a small update to fix couple issues. If you haven't yet seen 0.77 changelog. You can check it here. 0.77 contains much more improvements and fixes.

Changelog:
- Fixed a place near church backdoor where player can get stuck.
- Changed priority of some sounds to prevent some sound issues.

notes.title: v0.77 Silver crucifix, deadblind changes and more.
notes.notes:
Version 0.77 is now live. Spoilers are hidden behind black bars. If steam doesn't see new version of Witch Hunt, just restart steam.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/9f58b7f16c1ec2fb694f9f819f32224337d0cb21.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/9ad7d296a4ea5274121b1f95a6a1c2dd1ec68a4a.jpg

Changelog:
- Additional fix for invulnerable tree bug.
- Appearance of a deadblind changed. Deadblind is now much more easier to spot.
- Thunder totem replaced with silver crucifix.
- Now at some point, something happens to [spoiler]doctor.[/spoiler]
- Now game gets saved after watcher totem installation.
- Added information regarding darkness sense radius in darkness sense description.
- Fixed bug that prevented grass to be rendered on any quality settings if you chose fastest or low quality setting at some point.
- Witch will now use blind scream in its first stage when she's near the player.
- Level design changes in Bellville. Backdoor of the church can now be opened.
- FOV slider no longer blocked on fastest and low quality settings.
- Added warning message regarding FOV on fastest and low quality settings.
- Fixed bug that prevented options warning message about Ultra quality to be displayed.
- Fixed some places where player could stuck.
- Added tutorial message about run button.
- Added horns to final boss.
- Added tip "1 meter = 3.3 feet"
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: v0.76 A Hotfix for version 0.75
notes.notes:
Version 0.76 is now live. This version is identical to version 0.75 but it does contain fix for players who launched 0.75 and experienced invulnerable sacrificial tree bug.

Below is a changelog for version 0.75 if you missed it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30300240/de82e236bee1da01f8d0f42b24d2aeac3baa8a8d.jpg

Changelog:
- Added watcher totem to the game.
- Sacrificial tree health reduced by 33%.
- Undead run speed is now 20% lower.
- Adjusted volume of sounds that come from undead.
- Spider running speed significantly lowered.
- Witch move speed in its first phase lowered.
- Removed fast walk skill from the game.
- “To town” button no longer displayed in inventory when you don’t have “Fast travel” skill or you’re in town.
- Made options menu warning messages more obvious.
- Added warning message in option menu about ultra quality graphics setting.
- Added 2 new tips.
- Chinese translation significantly improved.
- Fixed small font size issue for item descriptions in Chinese version.
- Made improvements to texts in English version.
- Fixed bug that allowed player to walk through the door of the house with safe.
- Fixed bug that prevented part of the interface to be visible on gamma selection screen at ultra wide resolutions. 
- Fixed bug in save and load system, that caused thunder totems to be spawned on a map when it shouldn’t be spawned.
- New shop icon for thunder totem.
- Mana requirement for second chance skill lowered to 35 mana.
- Some other small improvements and changes.

notes.title: Live version on steam temporary reverted to v0.74
notes.notes: Critical bug was found in version 0.75, so current live version on steam is temporary reverted to 0.74. Version 0.75 will get back on steam when this bug will be fixed and build with the that fix will be tested.
